name: Why should I install a kitchen backsplash?

mainEntity.name: Why should I install a kitchen backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen backsplash protects your walls from splashes, stains, and moisture, especially behind sinks and cooktops. It's a practical and aesthetic upgrade that makes cleaning easier and adds significant visual appeal to your kitchen, tying together countertops, cabinets, and flooring. A well-chosen backsplash can also increase your home's value.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen backsplash protects walls from splashes and stains, simplifies cleaning, and enhances your kitchen's overall aesthetic and value.
